resources.string: After a phone restart, start Shizuku again using either method. You do not need to reinstall it or repeat pairing unless Shizuku asks.
Set up with a PC · USB
Connect your phone to a PC with a USB data cable.\nOn Windows, open Sukut → Phone. Follow its step-by-step guide.\nBack here, allow Sukut when Shizuku is running.
Set up on this phone · Wi-Fi

Install Shizuku from Google Play.
Enable Developer options: in About phone, tap Build number seven times (OS version on Xiaomi).
Connect to Wi-Fi. In Developer options, enable USB debugging and Wireless debugging.
Open Shizuku → Pairing. In Wireless debugging, choose Pair device with pairing code. Enter the code in the Shizuku notification.
Return to Shizuku and tap Start. Come back here and allow Sukut.
Find Pairing and Start in Shizuku
Wireless setup needs Android 11 or later. Use the PC method on this phone.
